title: LightmapGI baked preview on editor does not disappear when the node is hidden in Compatibility renderer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable, v4.4.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads)

### Issue description

Take a look at this image

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/04516294-a5f2-4d02-95e5-b29ae0d662dd)

This is the image after and before LightmapGI is baked. Notice how the shadow is softer in the baked image (probably not the best example). In Mobile renderer, we could preview the unbaked state by just hiding (pressing the eye icon) the LightmapGI node on the Scene dock. This was not the case when the project is on Compatibility renderer. Hiding the node will still result on the baked state. Only then when removing the light_data property from LightmapGI node's inspector dock will show the unbaked state.

### Steps to reproduce

- download and open the MRP
- make sure it's currently on Mobile renderer at the top right corner
- open the node_3d scene
- (optional) hide the LightmapGI gizmo to make inspecting changes easier

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4eea60bc-24b2-4ae9-940e-1205e6b94283)

- try to toggle hide/unhide the LightmapGI node on the Scene dock. notice that it switch between the baked and unbaked result. This equals with the result when you revert the light_data property of the LightmapGI node on the Inspector dock and then undoing it.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/11e3565e-5a51-4f41-9402-bf119bee86e4)

- now switch to Compatibility renderer, let it reload the project
- do the same thing, toggle hide/unhide the LightmapGI node on the inspector. Notice how it does nothing. While modifying the light_data property still does the expected result

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[compatibility-lightmap-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18808864/compatibility-lightmap-bug.zip)
